description: The Capacity of the Design Cooling Plants for District Cooling Projects by the Project Status and Economic Activity (Cooling Tons) is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. This dataset presents the cooling capacity of district cooling plants in Qatar, categorized by economic activity, project status, and type of capacity (designed or expected). Values are reported in tons of refrigeration (TR), offering insights into planned and potential infrastructure capacity. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are district, cooling, capacity, designed, expected. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-04-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
